sonnet.problem: The joke reuses the shape of the card 5 joke. Both set a big Bible number against Papa Dorin's own 'one batch' ('I lose count of the chocolate chips in ONE batch' and 'all I ever get out of my oven is the one batch I put in'). Stop 2 card 3 also leans on a 'batch' comparison.
sonnet.rule: Each joke idea, comparison and punchline shape is used once per lesson. A callback is the one exception, and it adds something new.
